name: vdp-textbook
$comment: The textbook Van der Pol equation x'' - mu (1 - x^2) x' + x = 0 at mu = 0.1, 1, 5 and 20, each as a block diagram and as an equation block, from x = 0.5, x' = 0; time is tau.

annotations.text: **Block diagram** of x'' = mu (1 - x^2) x' - x: Sq = 1 - x^2, times x' (Prod), times mu, minus x, integrated twice (Y gives x', X gives x). **Eq** is the same equation as an equation block; the cycle Meter reads the block diagram's period T_s and amplitude.

**Block diagram** of x'' = mu (1 - x^2) x' - x: Sq = 1 - x^2, times x' (Prod), times mu, minus x, integrated twice (Y gives x', X gives x). **Eq** is the same equation as an equation block; the cycle Meter reads the block diagram's period T_s and amplitude.

**Block diagram** of x'' = mu (1 - x^2) x' - x: Sq = 1 - x^2, times x' (Prod), times mu, minus x, integrated twice (Y gives x', X gives x). **Eq** is the same equation as an equation block; the cycle Meter reads the block diagram's period T_s and amplitude.

**Block diagram** of x'' = mu (1 - x^2) x' - x: Sq = 1 - x^2, times x' (Prod), times mu, minus x, integrated twice (Y gives x', X gives x). **Eq** is the same equation as an equation block; the cycle Meter reads the block diagram's period T_s and amplitude.

**Van der Pol, x'' - mu (1 - x^2) x' + x = 0**, from x = 0.5, x' = 0, in tau (the run time). Four subsystems at mu = 0.1, 1, 5 and 20; open one for its block diagram and equation block. Small mu: a near-sine of amplitude 2 and period 2 pi (1 + mu^2/16). Large mu: relaxation oscillations, slow drifts along the branches |x| > 1 and fast jumps, period about (3 - 2 ln 2) mu + 7.014 mu^(-1/3).

cards.title: Van der Pol: x'' - mu (1 - x^2) x' + x = 0

options.text: Four oscillators, each with its own **mu**, from the same start (x0, x0'). Every trajectory winds onto its **limit cycle**: a circle of radius 2 for small mu, a relaxation loop with slow drifts and fast jumps for large mu.
